# prime-badge

prime-rs: Badge component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/badge) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-badge)

Badge — port of `p-badge` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes match PrimeNG (`p-badge p-component` + modifiers, `data-p`), but instead of the
`<p-badge>` host element a `<span>` is rendered: the theme CSS is bound to classes, not to the tag name.

Properties are `Prop`/`OptProp`: a value creates no reactive primitives, a signal subscribes the attributes.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_badge::{Badge, BadgeSeverity};

let html = view! { <Badge value="5" severity=BadgeSeverity::Danger /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-badge-circle") && html.contains("p-badge-danger"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-badge = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["badge"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
